title: 第5章 姐，做我的女人，我来保护你
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
李秋霜也不知道她想让李大壮弄什么，但她却知道，这件事，只有李大壮能做，也只有李大壮能浇灭自己身上的火……

    她情不自禁的，用最纯洁却妩媚的姿态，缠上了李大壮高大的身躯！

    这种笨拙的热切，勾的李大壮浑身滚烫，独属于合欢宗的秘法，在他体内蠢蠢欲动……

    他再也忍不下去了，两只大手掐住李秋霜的杨柳细腰，稍微用力一转……

    李秋霜情不自禁的仰起修长脖颈，樱桃小口微微张开，娇喘中带着丝丝克制不住的哼叫。

    “嗯~~大壮，好热~~~~~”

    李大壮“火气冲天”，火热的大手隔着薄薄的夏衣，终于……

    “啊~~~”

    李秋霜叫的更大声了，一双温柔如水的美眸里，全是热切的渴望，白嫩细致的脸蛋儿上，也浮现出丝丝红晕，像是院子你葡萄藤上，熟的正好的那串红葡萄，鲜艳欲滴，让人看一眼，就忍不住流口水！

    李大壮再也忍不住，亲上那红扑扑的脸蛋儿……

    尝过才知道，李秋霜的滋味，简直比满是甜水的红葡萄还好吃，她的脸蛋儿香香的，嘴唇也香香的……

    而李秋霜，仿佛融化成了村后的小河，香软无力的瘫在李大壮的怀里！

    就在俩人即将更进一步的时候，李秋霜那个破旧的老式手机却忽然响了起来！

    “唔~”李秋霜被刺耳的铃声激的颤抖了一下，人也清醒了许多，看到自己和傻弟弟此刻的状态，本就红扑扑的脸蛋儿，瞬间羞的更红了，她手忙脚乱的想掏手机，却又不小心摸到李大壮……

    惹得李大壮闷哼一声！

    “秋霜姐，别接了，我难受！”李大壮像以前一样，对养姐耍起了赖。

    要是平常，李秋霜还真就依了他，可这会儿她已经回过神来，只觉得羞涩难当，身为大壮的养姐，却趁他傻的时候，这样勾引他，这也太没脸了！

    “不，不行！姐得先接电话！”李秋霜臊的坐不下去了，挣扎着要从李大壮怀里起身。
content_en:
Liu Meiyu's beautiful face was full of desire, she kept pushing her chest towards Li Dazhuang, her red lips were slightly opened, and she spoke seductive words.

    The evil fire that Li Dazhuang had finally suppressed surged up again. Why hadn't he noticed before that Liu Meiyu was so handsome?

    "Silly Dazhuang, what are you waiting for? Come on~~" Liu Meiyu couldn't wait any longer, stood up on tiptoes and hugged Li Dazhuang's neck.

    The faint feminine fragrance went straight into Li Dazhuang's nose. In the collar that Liu Meiyu had deliberately pulled down, two snowy mountains were swaying. The white color made Li Dazhuang dizzy, and the fire in his body shot straight to the top of his head!

    How can I bear this?

    Li Dazhuang threw the old turtle in his hand into the washing tub next to him, turned around and walked towards the house with Li Meiyu in his arms.

    "Dazhuang~~"

    Liu Meiyu seemed to have a premonition that she was about to be baptized by a heavy rain, and the earth, which had been thirsty for a long time, would definitely be full!

    Thinking of this, her delicate body was trembling with excitement!

    But at this moment, Li Dazhuang's ears suddenly moved. He seemed to hear a familiar female voice coming from the direction of his home, seeming to be shouting something!

    "What's wrong, Dazhuang? You silly boy is quite bad. You always keep others in trouble, and you have to let them do it themselves..." Liu Meiyu complained uncomfortably when she saw Li Dazhuang stopped.

    "Something's wrong, it seems like Sister Qiu Shuang is shouting!" After gaining cultivation, Li Dazhuang's ear power has also improved a lot. Although he can't hear clearly, it is indeed the voice of his adopted sister Li Qiu Shuang!

    "Sister-in-law, something might have happened to my family. I have to go back and take a look first. I'll leave you here first!"

    What could Li Dazhuang be doing when he was still in the mood? He got up and ran out. The old turtle was too big. If he was seen by outsiders when he carried it back, he would be easily missed!

    "Da Zhuang, your home is so far away, what can you hear!?"

    Liu Meiyu stamped her feet anxiously: "This silly boy, why did he lose his temper at the critical moment?"

    "Oh no! The look in Da Zhuang's eyes just now was as if he wanted to eat someone, but there was no trace of stupidity at all. Could it be that this bastard is really not stupid anymore and he was just lying to me!?"

    …………

    Li Dazhuang didn't know what Liu Meiyu was thinking. He was worried about Li Qiu Shuang!

    Li Qiu Shuang was picked up by Li Dazhuang's parents on the edge of a cliff on Xinghua Mountain ten years ago. At that time, the girl was sleeping on the edge of the cliff. She could fall off the cliff if she turned over!

    The old couple hurriedly woke her up, and upon asking, they discovered that the girl had lost her memory!

    She didn't know her name or where her home was. If it weren't for her smart and pretty eyes and the neat clothes she wore, the couple would have thought she was stupid!

    The old couple were kind-hearted and sent her to the law enforcement office, but the law enforcement office could not find her family. In order to prevent the girl from living in the orphanage, the old couple took her home. Seeing that she was taller than Li Dazhuang, they asked Li Dazhuang to call her sister!

    The two siblings have been together day and night for ten years, and their relationship is as good as the same person. Li Dazhuang never wants anything to happen to Li Qiu Shuang!

    But at this time, in the dilapidated yard of the Li family, Li Qiu Shuang was forced into a corner by Wang Yaogen, the son of the village chief with a lewd smile on his face!

    Li Qiu Shuang is beautiful and juicy, with white and tender skin. She is not like a rural girl at all. Her long braids hang down on her chest. Her plump and material chest holds her braids high. Her waist is as slender as a willow, and her long legs are thin and straight. She is trembling slightly because of fear, but it adds to her charming charm!
title_en: Chapter 4 I really thought there was no one left in my Li family! ?
